title: Machine learning on non-contrast CT texture predicts lung perfusion in suspected PE
summary: Texture features from non-contrast CT were selected and used in machine learning models to predict regional lung perfusion measured by Q-SPECT/CT, using 76 patients internally (12 for testing) and 49 externally. The model reached an AUC of 0.863 in internal testing and 0.828 on the external cohort, and voxel-wise perfusion surrogates were synthesized from selected feature maps. The study is retrospective with small cohorts and moderate AUCs.
ai_technology: Machine learning models on quantitative CT intensity and texture features

evidence.tested: Internal testing (12 patients) and an external test cohort of 49 patients, with spatial agreement against Q-SPECT scans.
evidence.unknown: Diagnostic value for PE in larger cohorts; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Selects CT features related to perfusion and builds models and surrogate perfusion maps from them.
